statement: offered gateway pairs in a gated scope the shipped data does not cover, each naming its missing input as one kind of the closed set `kinds` (what is missing and what closes it) and the detail for the model; an entry that becomes covered, leaves the gated scope, or that no saved catalog offers, fails the check (audit/gateway_coverage.py)

no_public_measurement.missing: a board reading of the model: no cached Artificial Analysis, arena.ai or Design Arena board lists it (or not with the input named), and no tier reading or relative gives a declared estimate
no_public_measurement.closes_when: a board lists the model, or a row of its series, at the next release's fetch

no_fleet_reading_at_effort.missing: a fleet reading at the effort: no model is measured on the facet at that effort and at a reasoning effort, so the fleet step that fills it (effort_steps) has no pair
no_fleet_reading_at_effort.closes_when: a board lists any model on the facet at that effort (for none: a non-reasoning listing) beside a reasoning listing, giving the fleet step its pairs

no_time_reading_in_series.missing: a reading of speed: an Artificial Analysis Time/Task (for responsiveness its measured time to first answer) of the model at some effort, of its larger model of the same version, or of a relative of the same maker and size (its own line, or another line within the declared version distance) read on a board: a same-series sibling gives only the ratio between efforts, never the time itself, and a relative's estimated time or responsiveness is never another row's basis
no_time_reading_in_series.closes_when: Artificial Analysis publishes a Time/Task (or a time to first answer) for the model, for its larger model of the same version, or for a relative within the declared version distance

no_relative_statement.missing: a row for the name: no public statement says which scored row it is (alias) or that it is the same model as one (same_model), and no board lists it
no_relative_statement.closes_when: a vendor or catalog statement relates the name to a row, or a board lists it as a row of its own

anchor_reading_moved.missing: a reading on the shipped scale: a board lists the model only in a fetch after the release snapshot, the board moved since, and fewer than two panel members are listed in both fetches to measure its drift (calibration/README.md, To add a model)
anchor_reading_moved.closes_when: the next release's fetch, which reads the model with every other row on one snapshot

other_weights_on_provider.missing: a provider_names declaration for the pair: the provider's own listing identifies the offered name as other weights than the row the name resolves to (models.dev gives the two different canonical ids), and accounts.json does not declare which row the name is on that provider
other_weights_on_provider.closes_when: accounts.json declares the row the name is on that provider (provider_names, citing the maker or models.dev, published with agentcompass data publish), or the provider's listing gives the name the row's canonical id
